scope: Shared actual supervisePilot/runWorker/createRemote nonbillable hosted verification, isolated tasks and central lifecycle; provider unavailable by construction; no paid permissions or operational ledger writes.
riskAnalysis: Owner eligibility and every action remain server enforced; UI cleanup must bind exact original record/source/release and distinguish stopped tests from verified central revocation.

threatModel.assets: Current owner session, task capabilities, isolated project key, immutable task/evidence/QA records, historical spending holds and durable approval registry.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner browser to protected Node supervisor and Redis; restricted worker to exact task APIs and OpenAI; provider output to independent QA and backend acceptance.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale helper ownership substitution; lost prepare/init responses; hung renewal, controller or worker death; replay/concurrent initializer; forged terminal results; stale/foreign readback; owner workspace switch; cancelled transport suppressing diagnostic evidence; token disclosure in owner stream.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing current owner/member/workspace/same-origin checks, exact immutable bindings, durable CAS revocation and30slease, one initialization attempt, bounded renew/init/stall/cleanup, backend terminal result equality, narrow late diagnostic sink, zero-call isolated hosted probes and independent reviews.

rollback: Keep paid false; remove only temporary inert window; deploy exact reviewed disabled feature source and independently verify old/current/replacement brokers. Preserve original helper bytes, task records and uncertain holds. Revert feature-only reviewed changes if required, never Production or historical evidence.

defects.rootCause: Hosted verification artificial pauses exhausted twenty-second controller deadline before final polling despite worker completion.
defects.detectionGap: Local zero-latency transport hid the control-plane latency margin.
defects.regression: Actual handler/supervisor/worker success with350ms per request latency must renew and report completed with five boundaries before the unchanged deadline.
defects.historicalPrevention: Regression retains genuine timers and delayed HTTP-shaped responses; shortening only inert pauses creates five seconds of deadline margin without changing paid timeouts.

proactiveReview.architecture: Owner session starts tracked supervisor; separate restricted worker bearer invokes actual runWorker/createRemote HTTP ports; fixed zero-authority profile; isolated Redis CAS task/approval/capability/audit namespace. Operational ledger and provider path never selected.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing Vercel Pro/Fluid duration, Upstash CAS, owner session, restricted worker project credentials, native Responses contract and current official pricing reviewed.
proactiveReview.threats: Profile confusion, orphan activation, callback substitution, leaked task capability, replay/stale deployment/release, controller interruption, authority renewal after revoke, and partial initialization.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Startup absent, worker crash/stall, partial committed initialization loss, cancellation, central revoke, stale release, cleanup failure; hosted faults separated from actual infrastructure outage.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Lost committed responses, networkdisconnect, stuck renewals, wrong receipts, terminal races, Redis CAS concurrency and actual Node SIGKILL with30second real-time lease.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Auditor and QA implement and execute negative tests against actual entrypoints/handler/native request mocks and challenge fast completion/terminal behavior.
proactiveReview.recovery: Central exact-ID revocation before/after init, cleanup readback validation, hardkill lease fallback, no retries, pending usage preserved and separate replacement verification.
proactiveReview.readiness: No hosted claim until actual concurrent owner supervisor and separate worker requests observed and independently reviewed. No model accuracy/live paid workflow claim.
